tei:div.tei:p: rje 'gro mgon ras chen gyi lo rgyus/

༄༅/ /brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma mchog tu gyur pa ni rje 'gro mgon ras chen te/ khong gi yab ni gtsang gi gcung pa dug gong pa yin zhing*/ gdung rus gru gu mtshan dpal grags/ de'ang yab kyi nu bo dbus su tshong du song ba ma log nas/ yab rang dbus su nu bo 'tshol du 'ongs pa dol gyi tshong dus par ma na nu bo dang 'phrad/ der khong byon chang mang po drangs/ nu bo chang gis bzi nas der mgron po cig la rta kha tshan can sus kyang mi thub pa zhig 'dug pa de bshol kyang ma nyan par zhon nas rgyugs pas lcang gseb tu khyer/ lcang sdong la mgo brdab nas shi /de nas yab des g.ye'i glang sho re'i gad khar 'ongs nas tshong byas/ gtsang mo btsun chung ma dang 'dus nas lo 'ga' zhig bsdad/ de nas yar lung gi nya mo gzhung du 'ongs nas khu rje snying po la gnas po byas nas bsdad/ phyis tshong legs po byung nas gnas gzhi brtings/ der bu lnga bu mo gcig dang drug byung ba'i che shos 'byung grags/ de 'og 'byung skyabs/ de 'og glog 'byung*/ de 'og 'gro mgon rin po che yin te/ khyim ming 'byung rgyal chung shos gra bo/ sring mo skya rgyal zhes bya/ 'gro mgon rin po che nyid rje dus mkhyen gyi dgung lo sum cu rtsa dgu pa sa pho 'brug la sku 'khrungs/ byis pa'i dus su ri la re'u lug 'tshor song tsa na/ khong gar bzhud du 'ja' zug pa kun gyis mthong*/ khong gi yab kyang dad pa can yin pas khong gi nang du chos byed rnal 'byor pho mo mang po 'byon pas lan gcig rnal 'byor pa zhig gis yab la bu chung ltag 'di nga la bslang zer/ de ci lags byas pas bu tsha 'di la bud med gser gyi rgyan can mang po 'khor zhing 'dug de mkha' 'gro ma yin pas/ 'dis chos byas na rnal 'byor pa bzang po zhig 'ong zer yang khong gis ma phul/ de nas dgung lo dgu bzhes pa'i dus su 'khor ba la skyo ba skyes mi rtag pas rgyud bskul nas/

zangs rir chos bros la byon nas rnal 'byor pa mdzad/ der rje btsun 'bro sgom ras pa las rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje gtum po/ bde mchog snyan brgyud/ do ha dang thun 'jog la sogs pa'i dbang dang gdams ngag mang du gsan/ bsgom pa tsam gyis bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams nyin mtshan 'dres par byung*/ na bza' ras rkyang mdzad pas ras chen du grags/ de dus khong grogs mched gnyis yod pas grogs po de la ras chung pa zer/ de nas lo lnga tsam song ba na bla ma'i zhal nas sang phod de kho bo'i ro kho bos ri la skyel ba yin gsung pa la/ khong na so gzhon pas de'i don ma go gsungs/ de'i phyi lo zhang ston phyug po cig gis khong la zhabs dbang zhus pa'i rkyen gyis sku bsnyun par gda'/ de dus bla ma zhang sum thogs pa mtha' rtsar bzhugs pas khong gdan 'dren du btang bas/ phag mo gru pa dang mjal/ tshogs chos nyi ma 'ga' zhig gsan/ bla ma zangs ri gdig phug du byon nas gshegs par nye ba'i tshe/ ras chen gyis khong gi mchan 'og du dbu bcug nas da gdams ngag kyang ma tshar/ nyams myong yang ma rdzogs pas su la brten/ ji tsug bgyi zhus kyin bshums pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod la bka' brgyud zin pa zhig 'ong ba ngas shes te/ bla ma rje btsun pa'i lugs kyis dang po nas gdams ngag thams cad sprugs nas mi mdzad par nges shes thob nas dus gcig tu ston pa yin/ da khyod kyis rgya bsgom la brten dang*/ nga'i gdams ngag thams cad kho la yod/ khyod rang gi slob dpon yang yin pas legs par 'ong gsungs/ bla ma sku gshegs nas khong thugs rgyal che bas/ rje btsun ras chung ba'i slob ma 'di ga tsam yod pa la/ rgya sgom rang gi slob dpon yin yang brgyud pa mar la bda' ba'i don med dgongs nas dol du byon/ mtshur ston du dbang po la gtugs/ phag mo dpyal lugs/ rdo rje gtum po'i las kha tshar/ ras chung ba'i bzhi chos/ sems phyogs kyi man ngag sogs mang du gsan/

de nas yar lung du byon/ rdo rgyus brag la bsgoms pas rnal lam du rje btsun ma zhal gnyis ma g.yung drung ris dang bcas pa'i zhal gzigs/ der lo 'ga' tsam bzhugs pas nad pa sogs la phan thogs pa'ang byung gsungs/ de nas gnyal du byon/ gtsang ston dkon ne yab sras la bram ze chen po'i chos mdzod drug dang*/ snying po skor drug dang*/ phyag rgya chen po be'u bum la sogs pa mang du gsan/ 'jam dpal gsang ldan dang*/ drag po sum sgril la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs mang po dang*/ gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul la sogs pa'i bstan srung kyang mang du gsan/ zhi byed snyan brgyud la sogs pa gdams pa dpag tu med pa thugs su chud par mdzad cing*/ mjo mo rnam rgyan gyi gzim sa nas tshur la ye shes kyi ḍā ki su khā ma hā siddhi'i zhal gzigs/ de nas za chu 'dus su chos rje sgam po pa'i zhal slob rlung dbu mar tshud cing 'od gsal rgyun chad med pa grub thob dar ma shes rab ces bya ba dang mjal/ dbang byin rlabs gdams pa dang bcas pa zhus/ de'i sos ka yur ma ran tsam na gnyal stong du byon nas nyin gcig dra cung ma ran tsam la yur ma ba 'ga'i 'dzar ba la bskru dgongs nas grog phug cig tu sgom zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bud med rgyab na slas po khur mi zhig byung nas bya bo zhig thogs nas 'dzar ba bskyal/ de'i phyin yar khyi 'ga' thal ba gzigs/ ci yin dgongs nas yar bzhengs nas gzigs pas/ bud med de rje btsun ma kho na bzhin du snang gsungs/ slar yar lungs su byon pa'i lam khar bla ma rje sgom zhig po'i phyags phyir 'brengs nas/ slob dpon bi ma la mi tra'i rdzogs pa chen po'i snying tig skor ma lus pa gsan/ yar klung du lo 'ga' bzhugs pa thugs dam smar ba ma byung nas/ da rang yul rna bas ma thos pa zhig tu 'gro dgos dgongs nas ngam shod smad gang bar lce grong du byon/ g.ye chung skor/ glang lung du slob dpon thod pa bsam 'grub la/

jo mo lab sgron gyi gdams ngag skor gcod yul ma lus pa gsan/ de nas dwags po la brgyud nas kong po'i la bar la byon/ bla ma gtsang pa mnga' ris pa dang mjal/ phyag na rdo rje gos dmar can dang*/ rtog pa tshod 'dzin dang*/ rdo rje legs pa'i sgrub thabs byang bu nyer lnga pa la sogs pa gdams ngag mang du gsan cing*/ spu bo la byon pas dge bshes gnyal pa jo sras dang mjal/ khong gi yi ge 'don zhing chos zhus pas thugs la btags/ phag mo chos drug dang*/ 'jam dpal pa la pa ṭa la sogs pa sgrub thabs yig sna mang po'ang zhus shing*/ khyad par du mgon po lcags par ma gnang nas zhal yang gzigs/ de khong la zhus pas khyod la las 'phro yod par 'dug da khyod kyi sdong grogs byed pa yin gsungs/ de'i dus su sgrub rog byas pas kyang nus pa thon nas phyis khong gis gsung ba ltar byung*/ de'i tshe rje btsun 'tshol ba la yum gyis gcen po btang nas byung*/ kho na re dbus su 'byon dgos/ khyed ma byung na ma rgan mo lceb zer nas nga btang ba yin zhes nan tan byed du byung ba la/ nga mi 'gro khyod rang yar log la song gsungs pas/ ye mi 'gro na ngas khyod kyi mgo de bcad la khyer ba yin zer ba la/ de kun sngar byis pa'i dus kyi gtam yin/ da khyod kyis nga mi thub 'on kyang 'o skol zas nor med par/ dbus su song bas mi rnams kyis sprang po kham log ces sus kyang mi brtsi bas/ da sa smad nas nor 'dra btsal te yar 'gro'o zhes gsung zhing*/ brid nas khong mched gnyis jo sras dang gsum po tsha ba sgang du byon pas sku bsod bzang po skyes/ de nas smar khams la byon/ chos zhu ba mang du byung*/ dbang bskur yang mang du mdzad/ de nas po 'bor smad 'bu yul du byon/ 'gong smad du 'gong pa nang 'khrug byung ba'i dum mdzad/ gnam lcags bya ba'i dpon la zhus nas sngags pa bzhi bcu skor tsam gyi sngags sde btsugs/ spyir 'gro mgon gyis yul de phyogs su mgon po'i sngags sde bco brgyad btsugs shes gtam du grags shing*/

de dag nas brgyud pa'i sngags pa'i gzugs brnyan thar thor da dung yang snang ngo*// de'i tshe kaṃ po gnas nang na chos rje rin po che dus gsum mkhyen pa bzhugs pa gsan te/ chos zhu rgyu med phyag cig 'tshal ba dang*/ kaṃ po gnas nang la ltad mo zhig lta ba la 'gro dgos dgongs nas 'gong smad nas yar byon pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang*/ dge bsnyen rdo rje dpal brtsegs rta pa mang po'i tshogs kyis bsu ba byas/ gnas nang du chos rje dang mjal bas khyod sngags chung shes rab can cig 'dug /nga'i slob ma byas na 'ong bar 'dug pa la gsungs/ khyed la slob ma ci 'dra ba bdog zhus pas/ 'bal tsha stag del ba dang lde chung sangs rgyas la sogs pa yod khyed rang yang de rnams kyi rtsar song gsung ste byon pas/ lde chung sangs rgyas dang phrad/ kho na re/ khyod sngags chung shes rab can nga'i bla ma'i slob ma byas na 'ong bar 'dug pa la/ da khyod nga'i grogs po 'bal tsha stag del ba'i rtsar song zer nas byon pas/ phug pa zhig na stag chen po zhig nyal te 'dug pas shin tu skrag nas bros te byon/ rgyu mtshan bshad pas da rung song dang zer nas phyin tsam na stag med par mtsho chung cig 'dug /de la bskor ba 'ga' byas rde'u gcig gnyis bskyur log ste byon nas/ grogs po la rgyu mtshan gsungs pas/ da rung lan gcig song dang zhes zer nas byon pa na/ mtsho de med par sgom chen cig 'dug ste/ mgo dang pang na sngar bskyur ba'i rde'u rnams 'dug cing*/ des kyang snga ma bzhin sngags chung shes rab can nga'i bla ma'i slob ma byas na 'ong ba cig 'dug pa la zhes zer ba la/ slob ma la yon tan 'di lta bu yod pa la/ bla ma la ni lta smos kyang ci dgos snyam du dad pa rang dbang med pa skyes/ chos zhus nas lo bdun la dbuu sa la mi 'bebs pa'i dam bca' mdzad de thugs dam gyi phu thag bcad/ stag del bas zad par gyi bkod pa bstan tshul 'di/

rgya ras dang ma ti ratna gnyis kyis bsgrigs pa'i rnam thar du mi 'byung yang*/ bdud rtsi bum bzang du 'byung ba ltar bkod cing*/ dpa' bo'i chos 'byung du gnas nang pa'i ngag sgros bskyar bar/ ras chen pas nus pa 'gran par bzhed de rje dus mkhyen gyi drung du byon pas/ phug pa cig na sgom chen bsgres po cig 'dug pa mthong bas zil ma bzod de phyag byas/ nga khyed dang nus pa 'gran dgos byas pas nga rgas pas khyod dang 'gran pa mi 'ong*/ khyod la mgron zhig bya gsungs nas chu ka pā la do khog mar blug /se ru rus pa skud pa la btags pa cig thab gong na bkal 'dug pas lan gnyis dkrugs te khol ba dang*/ gnyis kas ka pā la re gsol bas sngon ma myong ba'i ro bcud dpe med par myong bas dad pa skyes/ khyod rang nus pa 'gran na nga'i slob ma lde chung sangs rgyas kyi sar song gsungs/ khong gis sngar ltar 'bal tsha stag del ba lung bstan nas lus sprul bsgyur zad par gyi bkod pa mthong*/ der khong dang gtum mo'i drod 'gran par byas nas dgun sgang chen mtshan mo phu chu'i chab rom gyi steng du stod du stag del ba gcer bur bzhugs/ ras chen pas rdo rgyang gang tsam gyi smad du de ltar bzhugs pas/ stag del pa'i 'doms skor gsum gyi chab rom zhu nas chu tshan ltar gyur kyang mthur du 'babs ma bcug par gyen du bskyil bas khong rang gyi sku lus la gyen du 'khyil zhing rlangs pa dang 'dres pas sprin brtsegs pa ltar gyur te 'dug /ras chen pa bzhugs pa'i skus gar khyab yid tsam zhu nas cung dro bar gyur kyang khong gis chu rlung gi zer btang bas shin tu grang bar gyur ba'i tshe/ tho rangs kyi cha la rje dus mkhyen nam mkha' la byon nas/ stag del ba khyod kyis sngags chung 'di 'khyags rir ma bsad gsungs pas/ khong gis ting nge 'dzin klod pa na chu tshan gyis rgyun gyi chab rom thams cad dus gcig tu khyer skad/

der dad pa cher skyes nas bla ma'i zhabs la gtugs zhes sgrogs shing snang ngo*/ /zhes 'byung*/ der chos rje'i zhal nas kyang dbus pa rnyed pa 'tshol ba zhig la/ khyod dang bka' gdams pa gnyis rnyed pa che'o gsungs/ bla ma res chen khyod da lta skyid pa yin no/ /g.yeng ba med par gcig pur bsgoms pas chog snyam tsam na/ g.yeng bas sdod du mi ster ba da gzod khyod la gyod cig 'ong gsungs te/ ji ltar gsung pa bzhin phyis gdul bya rgya chen po dang*/ sku bsod bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig pur bzhugs dbang med pa byung gsungs/ phyis dbang bskur zhig gi gral du chos rjes kyang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal gzigs shing*/ rje btsun gyis kyang bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du zhal gzigs/ yang gnas nang du slob dpon bka' gdams pa'i chags phyir dpon slob mang po chos rje la phyag skyel du byon pa'i lam khar nyi ma ri sked du sleb tsam na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbus na/ chos rje rin po che bzhugs pa zhal gzimags/ mos gus dpag tu med pa skyes/ de dus chos rje rin po che krer bzhud pas ma mjal/ de nas logs su dgon pa 'dzin pa bas/ dben pa dga' dgongs nas slob dpon bka' gdams pa'i drung du lo gsum bsgoms/ de'i tshe bka' gdams pa'i zhal nas/ ras chen pa khyed rab tu byung na gzhan la phan pa yin pa la gsungs nas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas sngar gnas nang du chos rje rin po che yang gsungs la/ nga rang gi bla ma zangs ri ba dang*/ sgom rten pa lta bu byung na spun yin yang chog zhus nas rab tu ma byung*/ da khyed kyang de skad gsung*/ chos rje'i yang dgongs par 'dug pas rab tu 'byung dgos gsungs te/ dgung lo sum cu so bdun mkhan po la khrom pa dang*/ slob dpon bka' gdams pa gnyis la rta bzang ba re re phul nas/ kha skong dang bcas pa'i tshogs kyi dbus su bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/

rab byung gi mtshan bsod nams grags su btags/ de tsam na nga bsnyen par rdzogs pa 'phyis zin dgongs pa byung*/ slob dpon bka' gdams pa'i drung du sbas dung rin chen rdo rje zhes bya ba zhig gis maṇḍal phul ba'i dus su/ khong mig nam mkha' la blta zhing 'dug pas/ de ci yin snyam nas yar gzigs tsam na/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbu thog na chos rje rin po che bzhugs pa gzigs gsungs/ yang slob dpon bka' gdams pa'i dbang bskur zhig gi gral du khong bdag bskyed ji ltar mdzad pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskyed pa la sogs pa gsal bar gzigs/ khyad par du ye shes 'bebs pa'i tshe sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na ḍā ki ma lcags kyi mda' gzhu can bzhis/ khong dmigs pa gar gtad du mda' gzhu wang wang byed pa gzigs/ dbang tshar nas slob dpon la zhus pa/ de ka ltar yin gsungs/ khong gi lo rgyus de mkhan po la bshad/ mkhan pos slob dpon la gsungs pas/ slob dpon gyis ras chen khyod mthong mthong mang po bshad pa ang gsungs nas bkyon/ mkhan po ni shin tu dad nas mkhan po yin yang dbang bskur zhus/ ¿ de nas chos rje rin po che sa stod du byon zla gle du karmar chags phebs zer ba gsan nas/ sngon chos rje dbus su bzhud gsung dus/ nga la yang dbus dga' ba yin gsungs pa la/ dbus pha yul yin pas mi 'gro ba'i dam bca' yod pa lags zhus nas ma phyin pa yin/ da yang khong dbus su bzhud na zhal mi mjal bas phyag 'tshal du 'gro/ dpe cha kun sa smad du bzhag /rin po che dbus su ma bzhud na dpe cha yar len nas drung du bsdad pas chog gsungs te yar byon/ lam khar gsu shod mdzer chung du ru dpon dkon mchog bla ma la dbang bskur zhig mdzad pa'i dus su rje btsun ma zhal bzur nas bzhugs pa zhig gzigs/ de khong gi dam tshig la skyon yod pa'i brdal 'dug /khams kyang bag tsam ma bde gsungs/

de nas karmar rin po che dang mjal/ lo gsum bzhugs/ gdams ngag gi rting pa thams cad tshar bar zhus/ dbus su e bzhud zhus pas/ nga na ning nas kyi de yin mod/ gsungs te dbus su 'byon pa la rta shod rnam rgyang bar du skyel thung mdzad/

de nas smar khams su byon te dgon pa btab nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ lan cig gi tshe 'bo 'og drug tsha dkon mchog skyabs la dbang bskur zhig mdzad tsam na/ chos rje rin po che mdun gyi nam mkha' la byon nas mig 'khrul pa yin nam snyam te/ ji ltar bltas kyang mi yal bar yun ring po'i bar du bzhugs pa mthong zhes gsungs/ yon sgom grags yes rdo rje gtum po'i tshogs mchod zhus pa'i dus su/ bum pa'i nang nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje sku chung la yan lag rags pa cig zhal gzigs/ gnas nang du bla ma ro zan na ba'i tshe rim gro byed pa'i tshogs gral du/ rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa cig gzigs te kho 'chi ba'i rtag yin gsungs/ lan cig rten gtor bskyangs tsam na/ rten gtor gyi nang du mgon po bya rog gdong*/ sku stod yan chad gtor ma'i steng du thon pa 'jigs su rung ba'i cha byad can cig zhal gzigs/ khyag gi nang du khyag dpal dar gyis dbang bskur zhus pa'i dus su/ chos rje rin rin po che nam mkha' la ber thul rkyang pa cig bsnams nas byon pa zhal gzigs/ mdo lam dgon par phag mo dpon g.yog gsum zhal gzigs/ pum 'bor du dpon rdo rje seng ge la dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe sindhu ra'i maṇḍal gyi steng na rje btsun ma g.yung drung ris dang bcas par zhal gzigs/ gnas nang nas gzhan du 'byon dgongs pa'i tshe dge bsnyen rdo rje dpal brtsegs ma dga' nas cho 'phrul btang bas/ de nub kho'i mgo thog tu phyag na rdo rje bskyed de bzhag pas/ sang tho rangs kha bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gtum po sku nam mkha' gang ba/ zhabs dge bsnyen gyi mgo thog tu bzhag pa zhal gzigs/ cho 'phrul yang zhi zhing ci gsung bsgrub par dam bcas so// dge bshes khang rtse ston pa la snyan brgyud gsan par dgongs nas zhus pas ngas khyod kyi slob dpon mi 'ong*/

khyed grub thob chen po lags/ gsung skad/ cis kyang gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ 'o na khyed kyis nga la skyabs 'gro zhig gnang bar zhu gsungs nas/ rje btsun gyis skyabs 'gro zhig gnang*/ da khyed la 'bul chog pas mchod pa rgyas par gyis gsung*/ de nub rje btsun ma nag mo shangs kyi steng na lcags kyi 'khor lo 'khor ba zhig zhal gzigs/ chos de shin tu gnyan pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ zheng grong na bzhugs pa'i dus su mtshur phur chos rje rin po che 'das pa mkhyen te/ mchod pa mdzad pa'i tshogs gral du chos rje rin po che zhal gzigs nas/ thugs rje chen po'i nyi ma de// bdag la nub pa cang e srid// mjal bar zhu dang rin po che// zhes pa la sogs pa'i gsol 'debs kyi mgur bzhengs/ yang le'u ti na 'das mchod cig gi dus su rin po che dang rje btsun ma zhal gzigs/ lar de 'dra la zad pa med gsungs/ yang sa smad na bon po brtul ba'i dus su rje btsun mas phod cig btsugs pa gzigs/ da res bstan pa'i dbu thon par 'dug dgongs pas de bzhin du byung*/ de nas gnas nang du byon pa'i dus su nub cig gi tshe rje btsun ma sprin gyi gseb nas sku stod phyung ste bzhugs pa zhal gzigs/ de phan chad shin tu nag pa dang tshur ngos shin tu gsal bar gzigs pas/ nag phyogs der 'gro mi rung ba'i brdar dgongs/ yang gnas nang du nub cig dpal ye shes kyi mgon po byon nas phyag gis g.yug stangs mdzad de/ ngas phar ngos phyogs thams cad bde bar byas yod/ khyod kyi bstan pa ngas bton gyi nga la bstod pa cig gyis zer ba la/ bdag ni rnal 'byor sgrub pa po// khyod ni chos skyong dam tshig can// zhes pa la sogs pa'i bstod pa mdzad/ de'i dus su bon po stag skor dge bsnyen la oṃ bzhag la yin gsungs te/ rje bka' drin can de tur gyis dran// maṇḍal phul zhing gsol ba btab// smon lam las 'phro gzhir bzhag nas//

bstan pa rin chen sa gzhi 'di// dar zhing rgyas par 'dod pa'i phyir// brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bu skal ldan bdag skyobs byin gyis rlobs// zhes sogs bon po las rgyal ba'i mgur bzhengs/ de nas sngon chos rje'i gsung gis dbus su phyin na dga' ba yin gsung pa la/ dbus skyes pa'i yul yin pas de mi gsung bar zhu/ gzhan gar song na mi la phan zhus pas/ rme 'dor zhing khams dkar ba yin/ chos byed kyi 'dug sa yang bzang*/ gzhan la yang phan pa 'ong gi der song gsung nas lung bstan/ lar de dus dbus su phyin na gdul bya 'di las che ba 'ong bar 'dug pa la gsung*/ de ji ltar lags zhus pas/ de nub dbus kyi 'dun pa btang nas nyal ba'i rmi lam na/ rje btsun ma sku la rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'od zer 'phro ba cig mthong gsungs/ de nas blo bur du chib pa bzang ba 'ga' re bdog nas nye gnas kyang mang po ma khrid par sa stod du bros ma thabs su/ 'byon shul du sbyin bdag rnams kyis mya ngan chen po byas/ de nas rme 'dor du shal ba'i mi dpon rnams kyis yon bdag byas te skungs su lo 'ga' bzhugs/ de'i tshe smar khams kyi mkhan po la spring yig mdzad pa/ oṃ swa sti/ rigs ldan gsum gyi sems dpa'// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan// mi nub bstan pa'i srog shing*// smon 'jug chos kyi 'khor lo// rtogs pa mchog gyur nyi ma// sdom gsum mdzes pa'i rgyan can// dngas gsal lam gyi sgron me// rtag chad sel ba'i lam mkhan// don dang mthun pa'i mkhan po la// ras chen gyis spring ba/ dmar smar khams nga'i 'dug lugs dang*/ dus tshod dang*/ spyod lam dang*/ bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib bsams pas/ de tsam yin nam snyam te song ba de la/ mkhan po ba ma mnyes zer ba thos nas/ nga shin tu mi dga' bar gyur/ de'i bzod gsol la na bza'i rgyu dang*/ jo sras kyi stan cig mchis pas/ 'di bzhes la thugs khrel mi mdzad par zhu/

dgos nged ma shi phyag 'tshal ba'i dus e 'byung lta/ sems la gdung ba ni preng nge yod pas thugs kyis dgongs par zhu/ nga sprang po yang sgrub pa smar na des chog gam snyam/ snang ba thams cad lhan cig skyes// yengs med pa yi bzod gsol byed// ma bcos tha mal shes pa la// tshogs drug mi dgag gi bzod gsol byed// ci byed chos su 'gro ba la// gzhan don lhur len gyi bzod gsol byed// gnas lugs kyi don la grub mtha' med// kun dang mthun par de ltar lags// rje rin po che gsung bsgrub ste// 'dren pa rnams kyi gshegs shul snyegs// thugs rje dgongs shing byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs/ de'i khu tshur gyi gzhi bdag gis bar chad btang bar brtsams nas 'khor cig na ba la/ rje btsun gyis ting nge 'dzin mdzad de bar chad bsal/ rje btsun ma rus pa'i rgyan can phyogs thams cad na gar khyug khyug byed pa gzigs te/ khong dbang du 'dus pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ de nas karmar rje dus mkhyen gyi gdan sa mdzad du byon pa'i dus su rje btsun ma me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhal gzigs/ de gdan sa dar nas 'ong ba'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ de'i tshe/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma mos gus yin par 'dug/ yi dam bag chags yin par 'dug/ sgom pa kun rdzob yin par 'dug/ ces sogs gnas lugs kyi don la/ nges shes khyad par can 'khrungs pa'i mgur bzhengs/ de nas zla stod kyi sde dpon thams cad kyis zhu ba byas nas karma'i gdan sar chos rje rin po che'i sku tshab bzhengs/ mkhar lan thams cad mdzad/ rab gnas legs shing byin rlabs phul du byung ba dang ldan par gyur to// yang sum pa 'bro ldog gis rta khyer ba la ban dmag byas pa'i dus su/ rje btsun ma rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhig gzigs te/ bstan pa thon pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ de nas ri lto nang yan chad du byon/ gnas gzhi 'bul ba dang*/

dkor nor gyi 'bul ba byung ba rnams gdan sa'i cha rkyen du bzhag nas yang shar phyogs su byon te skungs dgon par rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ jo bo thugs rje chen po'i zhal gzigs/ 'bri klung du dbon chos kyi grags pas gdan drangs te/ gnas gzhi brgyan pa cig gis thog drangs khri rwa can gyi 'bul ba byas/ ras sde'i dgon pa phul nas der bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rje btsun ma rmog dang khrab gsol ba cig gzigs te/ lho brgyud du 'khrugs pa 'byung ba'i brdar dgongs tsam na/ chos dgon lho nas byung nas 'khrugs pa byung zer skad/ yang skungs na bzhugs pa'i tshe chos skyong gi bskul te/ song phod zon mdzod cig zer ba byung*/ de nas lho'i rta pa brgya lhag gis gdan drangs pas/ de'i phyi lo phyag bsnyungs te de'u 'das byung*/ chos skyong gis bskul pa de yin par 'dug gsungs/ de nas zla nyin na tshe ba kag la chos khrims rtsod pa'i dus su sku khams cung zad ma bde/ der rje btsun ma sku rgyab bstan pa cig gzigs/ dang por bzhes drangs/ de nas 'dun ma blangs pas phrag dog 'ong ba'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ de nas sku phan nas thang la byon pas nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang*/ yang ma tha na bzhugs pa'i dus rnal lam na rje btsun ma mchod rten ri rab med pa bsnams pa cig zhal gzigs/ ri rab med pa de tshe stod zad zer ba'i brdar 'dug / mchod rten bstan pa de da res la mi 'chi zer ba'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ yang karma na chos rje'i 'das mchod byed pa'i dus su bzhugs gdan la bla bre byas yod pa gzigs pas rkyen byas nas bla ma dran te/ rin chen rje la phyag 'tshal lo// nges pa don gyi rgya mtsho la// dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// bka' brgyud yid bzhin nor bu la// bag chags las 'phro rkyen snang gis// nges par med par bla ma dran// zhes sogs kyi mgur mang po bzhengs/ de la brten nas chos rje rin po ches thog drangs/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin gtibs pa lta bu zhal gzigs/ lar bla ma'i 'das mchod 'di rang ngo mtshar che bar 'dug gsungs/ yang skungs su dbang gral cig tu rje btsun ma gnyis kyis chos rje rin po che'i skuu brten nas bzhugs pa zhal gzigs te/ skye ma'i bla ma bka' drin can// mnyam nyid dus gsum mkhyen gyur pa// gzhan don zhen med thugs rje gzigs// mngon sbyangs las mthun lam sna drongs// bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs// 'gro la phan bde'ie dngos grub ni// mchog dang thun mong rnam gnyis stsol// nges shes rigs pa dngas gsal gyis// gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i lam 'phrang sgrol// zhe 'dod lam gyi gol sa ston// tha mal shes pa'i 'dug tshul la// bying rgod med par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs te/ nga'i skye ba snga ma'i yi dam de rje btsun ma dbu bcad ma yin par 'dug gsungs/ der nyer gnas mchod btsun gyis/ rje btsun rin po che'i yi dam zhal de skabs skabs su gzigs pa lags sam gtan du gzigs pa lags zhus pas/ 'o na chos kyi nang nas kyang*/ bde gshegs gcig sgom rgyal ba kun gyi ngang*/ mi zer ram dgos pa yod na ngas nam 'dod 'dod kyis mthong*/ ngas gzhan gyi yi dam gang yin de yang ngo shes/ sgom chen pa su mthong yang de'i nyams myong mtho dman de ngas shes gsungs/ 'on kyang sgyu ma lta bu'i snang ba la nges pa 'ga' yang med ces/ snang ba rten cing 'brel 'byung yin// rnam rtog blo bur rkyen snang yin// sems kyi bag chags dri ma yin// nyams kyi byed pa rten 'brel yin// zhes sogs kyi mgur bzhengs/ yang karmar bzhugs pa'-i tshe nub cig chos rje rin po ches gos rkyang pa zhig bsnams nas byon pa gzigs gsungs/ de ji ltar lags zhus pas byang ngos nas/ bstan pa rtsod dgos zhig 'ong bar 'dug gsungs de nas yun ring por ma thogs par rag nam gyi dge ru ded nas dkon mchog rtsod dgos par byung*/

de'i dus su rje btsun ma g.yu thogs nas byon pa gzigs te/ da res bstan pa thon pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi// sprul pa'i bka' brgyud rje la 'dud// smon 'jug gnyis kyi sa gzhi la// byed pa rgyu mthun rta pho rgyug/ ces sogs kyi mgur bzhengs/ rta mang na bzhugs pa'i dus rmang lam na bka' brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad byon/ de rnams kyang rang byung 'ga' tsam las phal cher rnal 'byor pho mo sha stag du 'dug pa la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tilli pa'i zhal nas/ nam mkha' la ni bya bzhin du// thogs med shes rab bzang po 'gro/ gsungs te lho nub kyi nam mkha' la 'phur nas bzhud/ de bzhin du bla ma re res tshigs su bcad par re gsungs shing 'phur te bzhud pa'i rjes la/ rje btsun nyid kyang 'phur la byon pas zla la cung zad ma sleb pa rmis gsungs/ re zhig sku khams cung zad ma bde ba'i tshe bla ma go bo mgo gling mtshur phur 'bul ba skyel pa'i lam zhor la karmar phyin pas mjal khong gis bsams pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'di lta bu sku bsnyung ba re 'phangs bsnyung nad 'di nga la 'phos na ci ma rung snyam tsam na/ de mkhyen nas grogs po khyed kyi sems bskyed de lta bu dgos pa yin gsungs/ kho shin tu dad par gyur te der phyag 'tshal 'bul ba bteg chos zhus par 'dug /lar gzhan rgyud mkhyen pa'i mngon par shes pa de lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' yang*/ shin tu gsang ba'i tshul gyis gzhan la mi gsung pa yin no/ /yang karmar dpal ldan lha mo rang byung rgyal mo'i zhal gzigs te/ nye gnas rnams la dpal lha mo'i sgrub thabs slob dang 'di 'khor bar 'dug /ngas gtor 'bul tsam yang mi shes te lan gnyis zhal mthong gsung rten gtor yang mdzad do// de nas dgung lo bdun cu bzhes pa'i tshe/ skabs shig khyed rnams zhag 'ga' gar yang ma 'gro /sang gnang 'di na mi khom pa zhig 'ong gsungs/

de nas zhag gsum lon tsam na dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes gsum la sku bsnyug sman pa la bstan pas da lan cis kyang mi phan kho bo 'gro ba yin sun ma byung nas lo gsum song gsungs/ 'o na nged rnams ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ gsol ba 'thob dang ngas khyed rnams 'dren par nus pa yin gsungs/ lar chos dang mthun par gyis dang legs par 'ong gi nga'i 'khor rnams la dge sbyor skyong rgyu med pa cher med/ sems ngo shes pa shin tu mang*/ nga mi dgos pa la'ang 'ga' re yod gsungs/ nga'i bla ma rnams kyang lho nub phyogs su bzhud pas nga yang de phyogs su 'gro ba yin gsungs te de ngos la zhal gzigs/ de nas tshes bco lnga'i nyin par de'u 'das byung bas dung bus grwa pa thams cad bsdus/ chos dang zhal ta shin tu mang bar mdzad de/ mkhyen pa gnyis la mnga' brnyes pa// dus gsum bstan pa'i sgron me 'dzin// smin grol sngags kyi rgyal por bzhugs// rigs drug ma rig ling tog bsal// zhes sogs kyi mgur yang bzhengs/ de'i dus su nam mkha' 'jas gang ba dang*/ 'od kyi gur phub pa la sogs pa ltas dang cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab par byung*/ dad mos kyis thams cad yid g.yos te/ gsol ba drag tu btab sku rim gsol 'debs rgyun byas/ de nub rje btsun gyi zhal nas gsol 'debs 'di shin tu gnad che bar 'dug nga da nang 'gro rgyu yin pa la khyed rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas da zhag 'ga' sdod par gda'/ lar kho bo shi ba dang ma shi ba khyad med thams cad mnyam nyid chen po yin gsungs/

yang lan cig gi tshe khye'u gzhon nu g.yu'i zur phud can cig gis chang 'dung bya gang gzung nas/ nga la lag mchod zhu zer du byung*/ de jo bo sngags bdag yin par 'dug 'dis lan gsum du ngas ci zer khas nyan par byas yod pas khyed rnams kyang gtor ma phul dang mthun rkyen thams cad 'grub/ de yang kho bo bsur phyin pa'i tshod du gda' gsungs/ yang nyi shu gnyis kyi nyin bar phyag thal mo lan 'ga' tsam sbyor zhing 'dug pa la de ji ltar lags zhus pas/ de kho de rig pa skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i don la nga gdod goms 'dris ma dgos par rang dbang thob pas bla ma drin re che snyam pas rje rin po che dran pa yin/ da 'o skol yang zhag gnyis tsam yin/ de'i bar la bla'o bya'o gsungs/ de nas nyi shu lnga'i tho rangs kha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa sems can gyi don la byon pa khyed rnams kyis e mthong gsungs/ nyi ma shar dros la sprul pa'i sku'i 'khor lo bsdus nas zhing khams gzhan du gshegs so// de nas gdung la mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshe/ 'ga' res phyag mchod mdzad par mthong*/ la las chos gsung ba dang gar gyi rnam 'gyur la sogs pa sku'i bkod pa sna tshogs pa'i mthong snang byung zhing*/ dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes gsum gyi nyin par gdung bzhu ba'i tshe/ nam mkha' la nyi ma mang du shar ba dang*/ sa gzhi la ring bsrel gyi char bab pa dang*/ bar snang 'ja' 'od kyis gang ba dang*/ lha'i rol mo'i sil snyan gyi sgra grags pa la sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ gzhan yang sku'i rten rgyal ba zhi khro'i sku mang po dang*/ gsung gi rten yi ge'i phreng ba dang*/ ljags mngon sum du byon pa dang*/ thugs kyi rten du mchod rten dang*/ phyag mtshan rang byon dang*/ thugs 'byung ba'i rkyen gyis gzhig par mi nus pa man shel dri ma med pa lta buu mngon sum du byon te/

gdul bya rnams kyi mos pa'i snang ba rab tu rgyas par mdzad do// de ltar rje btsun chen po 'di'i yon tan 'gro ba'i khams dang dbang po bag la nyal bsam gyis mi khyab pa ji lta bar mkhyen pa dang*/ dus gsum gyi shes bya'i dngos po ma lus pa mngon sum du gzigs pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi bkod pa sna tshogs pas/ 'gro ba'i don rab 'byams mdzad tshul rnams zhib tu brjod na bsam gyis mi khyab bo zhes 'byung ngo*//
